name: Stormbitten Wyvern · Galeborn style
role: Boss style · Ring 3 high cloud islands in clear weather · Void Pull is stronger, Lightning weaker
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as the Stormbitten Wyvern; only textures and added boxes change.
A wind wyvern: pale sky-blue scales, white belly, silver horns and spines, pale blue membranes, and two long cloth-like wind streamers trailing from the horns.
Config shifts its ability weights toward Void Pull (wing gust) and away from Lightning. The splinter stays violet.
Spawns on Ring 3 islands in clear weather.
